title: Read a simulated feature-status report
description: You can see how declared implementation flags partition a registry of test descriptions.

steps.description: IMPLEMENTED assigns a Boolean flag to each feature. These flags simulate project status.
TESTS lists a description, feature key, and expected output for each entry. Several entries share a feature key.

steps.question: Do these comprehensions compare actual interpreter output with expected output?
steps.answer: No. They classify entries using only the corresponding implementation flag.

steps.description: The two lists drive the printed status groups. A disabled feature can place multiple entries in the failing group.
The recording reports 9 of 15 feature flags enabled and 14 of 21 entries passing. Those are simulated counts rather than executed interpreter assertions.
